title: Markets Anticipate End Of Iran War
gist: Teaser (paywalled after the opening paragraph) by Anatole Kaletsky arguing that last week's Republican electoral wipeout leaves Trump only one route to a legacy in his lame-duck period, which the title identifies as ending the Iran war, and that this explains the global equity rally on Wednesday and the Thursday collapse. The text is truncated before the conclusion, so the Iran link comes from the title and the setup.

insights.claim: Gavekal's Kaletsky says a single simple explanation, rather than complex ones, accounts for the worldwide stock market rally last Wednesday, the Thursday collapse, and the Republican electoral defeat.
insights.speaker: Gavekal Research
insights.so_what: Market swings around the election are framed as driven by one geopolitical expectation, not by many separate factors.
insights.quote: Why did stock markets celebrate all over the world last Wednesday and then collapse on Thursday?

insights.claim: The Republican Party suffered its biggest electoral defeat in 50 years in last week's US election.
insights.speaker: Gavekal Research
insights.so_what: A wipeout of this size reshapes Trump's political constraints and incentives for the remainder of his term.
insights.quote: Why did the Republican Party suffer its biggest electoral defeat in 50 years?

insights.claim: The Republican wipeout leaves Trump with only one way to achieve his main lame-duck objective, which is securing an exalted place in US history.
insights.speaker: Gavekal Research
insights.so_what: If legacy-seeking drives policy, investors should expect Trump's actions to be directed at a single high-profile goal.
insights.locator: Occam’s Razor cuts through the complexities

insights.claim: Kaletsky argues Trump will not secure his legacy through projects like a White House ballroom or a triumphal arch, since the arch would be demolished once he loses power.
insights.speaker: Gavekal Research
insights.so_what: Implies a consequential foreign-policy achievement is the only legacy route left, consistent with the title's end of the Iran war.
insights.locator: Trump clearly craves an exalted place

insights.claim: Kaletsky's framing treats Trump as having already enriched himself and obtained personal immunity from the Supreme Court, so personal financial and legal motives no longer constrain him.
insights.speaker: Gavekal Research
insights.so_what: A strongly worded characterisation; it is a premise of the argument rather than evidenced in the visible text.
insights.locator: now that he has thoroughly enriched himself

insights.claim: Per the title, markets are anticipating an end to the Iran war, which Gavekal presents as the key driver of equity moves and the central input for investment conditions in the months ahead.
insights.speaker: Gavekal Research
insights.so_what: If correct, de-escalation is the base case to position around; the visible text does not give the supporting detail.
